pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā bhātuno saddhivihārikassa bhikkhuno ārocesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.3: ahaṃ āvuso sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpanno
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.5: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā saṅghaṃ tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.6: tassa saṅgho tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.7: so parivasanto taṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.8: “ahaṃ āvuso sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā saṅghaṃ tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ yāciṃ, tassa me saṅgho tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ adāsi sohaṃ parivasāmi, vediyāmahaṃ āvuso vediyatīti maṃ āyasmā dhāretū”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.9: kiṃ nu kho āvuso yo aññopi imaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati sopi evaṃ karotīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.11: ayaṃ āvuso āyasmā upanando sakyaputto sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā so me ārocesi mā kassaci ārocehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.14: atha kho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.15: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.16: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādessatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.17: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.20: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.22: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:1.23.1: “yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa jānaṃ duṭṭhullaṃ āpattiṃ paṭicchādeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.1.8: sāmaṃ vā jānāti, aññe vā tassa ārocenti, so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.1.10: cattāri ca pārājikāni terasa ca saṅghādisesā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.1.12: imaṃ jānitvā codessanti sāressanti khuṃsessanti vambhessanti maṅkukarissanti nārocessāmīti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.2.1: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā duṭṭhullāpattisaññī paṭicchādeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.2.2: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā vematiko paṭicchādeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.2.3: duṭṭhullāya āpattiyā aduṭṭhullāpattisaññī paṭicchādeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.2.5: anupasampannassa duṭṭhullaṃ vā aduṭṭhullaṃ vā ajjhācāraṃ paṭicchādeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.3.2: “saṅghassa bhaṇḍanaṃ vā kalaho vā viggaho vā vivādo vā bhavissatīti nāroceti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.3.3: saṅghabhedo vā saṅgharāji vā bhavissatīti nāroceti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc64:2.3.4: ayaṃ kakkhalo pharuso jīvitantarāyaṃ vā brahmacariyantarāyaṃ vā karissatīti nāroceti.
